summary: People can replace an ask's deadline answer for seven days with work override; the asker is told without undoing prior effects

replay.detail: Person answer views recognize replicated work.person-override claims. Overrides do not reopen or rewind completed work.

schema.detail: Registers work.person-override with the asking episode, named answer and overridden deadline claim; no SQLite table change.

rules.detail: Only the ask's person may override a deadline resolution within seven days. Each answer key is idempotent; a newer different answer becomes standing.

compatibility.detail: POST /v1/work/override and fractal work override are additive. All members must run an override-aware build to show the replacement answer.

manual.detail: No operator action is required. Deadline policy remains opt-in.

recovery.detail: Older builds do not show explicit overrides; upgrade again to restore their standing-answer view. Effects already taken on the default are never undone.
